title: Multi-LCB: Extending LiveCodeBench to Multiple Programming Languages
description: Researchers Maria Ivanova et al. present Multi-LCB, extending LiveCodeBench to evaluate LLM coding capabilities across multiple programming languages. Accepted at ICLR 2026, this benchmark addresses the need for comprehensive coding evaluation beyond single-language datasets.
author: Maria Ivanova, Pavel Zadorozhny, et al.

title: LedgerAgent: Structured State for Policy-Adherent Tool-Calling Agents
description: Paper by Md Nayem Uddin et al. introducing LedgerAgent, a structured state management system for policy-adherent tool-calling AI agents. Addresses key challenges in agent reliability and compliance with tool-use policies.
author: Md Nayem Uddin, Amir Saeidi, Eduardo Blanco, Chitta Baral

title: Automating SKILL.md Generation for Computer-Using Agents via Interaction Trajectory Mining
description: Research by Yuexing Hao and Xiaomin Li on automating SKILL.md documentation generation for computer-using agents through interaction trajectory mining. Addresses AI agent documentation and skill discovery challenges.
author: Yuexing Hao, Xiaomin Li

title: ORAgentBench: Can LLM Agents Solve Challenging Operations Research Tasks End to End?
description: Benchmark paper by Jiajun Li et al. evaluating whether LLM agents can solve challenging operations research tasks end-to-end. 31 pages examining agent capabilities in optimization and decision-making scenarios.
author: Jiajun Li, Mingshu Cai, Yixuan Li, et al.

title: Datasette Apps: Host custom HTML applications inside Datasette
description: Launched datasette-apps plugin for hosting custom HTML applications inside Datasette. Simon expanded on the 'why' - explaining the motivation and technical implementation details for this new capability.
author: Simon Willison

title: GLM-5.2 is probably the most powerful text-only open weights LLM
description: Chinese AI lab Z.ai released GLM-5.2 on June 13th, then released full open weights under MIT license on June 16th. This is a 753B parameter, 1.51TB Mixture-of-Experts model with 40 active parameters and 1 million token context window (up from GLM-5.1's 200,000). It's text-only input - Z.ai has a separate vision family.
author: Simon Willison

title: AI demands more engineering discipline. Not less
description: Simon quotes Charity Majors: 'What happened in 2025 was this: the economics of code production were turned upside down. Instead of being very hard, time-consuming, and expensive to generate code, it became effectively free and instant. Lines of code went from being treasured, reused, cared for and carefully curated, to being disposable and regenerable, practically overnight.'
author: Simon Willison (quoting Charity Majors)

title: Datasette 1.0a34 with row editing tools
description: Datasette 1.0a34 alpha released with tools to insert, edit and delete rows within the Datasette interface. The feature was inspired by Datasette Agent - Simon noted it was 'long overdue' and highlighted the irony that you could edit via chat but not the regular UI.
author: Simon Willison

title: State of AI in 2026: LLMs, Coding, Scaling Laws, China, Agents, GPUs, AGI
description: Lex Fridman Podcast #490 featuring Nathan Lambert and Sebastian Raschka discussing the state of AI in 2026. 4.5-hour conversation covering LLMs, AI coding, scaling laws, AI in China, agents, GPUs, and AGI timelines. Comprehensive overview of current AI landscape.
author: Lex Fridman with Nathan Lambert and Sebastian Raschka

title: Datasette Agent 0.3a0 with write SQL tool
description: Datasette Agent 0.3a0 released with new `execute_write_sql` tool that requests user approval and then writes to a database, taking user permissions into account. Enhanced terminal mode supports approvals with new options including --unsafe mode for auto-approving.
author: Simon Willison

title: Why AI hasn't replaced software engineers, and won't
description: Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kappor analyze AI job displacement through software engineering lens. Key insight: real bottlenecks are (1) deciding/specifying what to build, (2) verifying/being accountable for deliveries, and (3) deep human understanding of codebase/business/environment. Simon emphasizes AI helps with deciding and verifying but 'deep human understanding' remains key.
author: Simon Willison (citing Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kappor)

title: Publishing WASM wheels to PyPI for use with Pyodide
description: Following Pyodide 314.0 release announcement, Simon explores publishing WASM wheels to PyPI for use with Pyodide. Technical deep dive into WebAssembly, Python packaging, and browser-based Python execution.
author: Simon Willison

title: Statement on US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
description: The US government issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national. Anthropic received directive citing national security concerns about a 'jailbreak' method. Simon tracked when his access was cut off (6:59pm Pacific on June 12, 2026) and documented the technical details.
author: Simon Willison
